prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a premium standalone GAME VEHICLE RESOURCE, one complete powered-up Terran BATTLECRUISER on a TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, delivered as a PNG with real alpha. This is a game sprite / collectible transport cutout, not a scene or poster.

USER REQUEST: Express the Battlecruiser as an ultimate collectible means of transportation for a game. Add spectacular visual effects while keeping the entire ship's actual shape exceptionally clear. The result must immediately read as the famous StarCraft Terran Battlecruiser, not an invented round spacecraft.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1: Blizzard's official StarCraft Remastered Battlecruiser. PRIMARY SILHOUETTE reference: the characteristic wide blunt hammerhead-like armoured forward body, central structural spine, paired rear engineering masses, tall central command structure and multiple side-mounted batteries. Reconstruct this iconic substantial capital-ship architecture at dramatically higher visual quality. Ignore the ground tile scene, yellow team stripes, adjacent structure and cast shadow.
Image 2: Blizzard's official Han and Horner Battlecruiser unit. SECONDARY engineering reference for layered Terran armour, the bridge, side weapon batteries and blue reactor light. Do not inherit its tiny icon resolution or flat shading.

THE SHIP: One extraordinary, fully realized Terran Battlecruiser seen in a readable elevated FRONT-LEFT THREE-QUARTER view, nose toward the lower-left and engines toward the upper-right. Preserve its iconic thick blocky capital-ship proportions and broad transverse forward armour. A cohesive connected massive hull, robust central keel/spine, raised central bridge with readable tiny warm-lit viewport slits, two strong shoulder armour groups, mechanical aft engineering section and powerful recessed rear thrust nozzles. All major masses must be unmistakable even at inventory thumbnail size. Show the complete bow, both forward shoulders, port and starboard body masses, command tower and stern. It should look like a formidable transport/flying fortress a player would covet as the highest-tier mount, with a believable habitable bridge inside the vessel, not an exposed rider's saddle.

ART DIRECTION: Highly polished premium hard-surface GAME ART, precise bevels and broad well-lit planes, dense detail organized into LARGE coherent mechanical shapes. Gunmetal and clean graphite armour, brushed silver panel edges, restrained deep cobalt-blue team accent panels and very small muted brass trim. Moderate pristine industrial wear at the edges only; beautiful deliberate materials, no pervasive grime. A heavy, expensive military flagship, not jewellery. Multiple properly attached weapon batteries with clear barrel endpoints, carefully restrained sensor masts and clean armour joints. Do not mutate the ship into an organic animal, luxury sports car, manta, ring machine, Star Wars star destroyer or generic jet fighter.

SPECTACULAR BUT CLEARLY SEPARATED STATIC EFFECTS:
1. Three to four physically aligned rear thruster plumes erupt from ACTUAL AFT NOZZLES, blazing white-hot cores with electric blue/cyan outer flame and crisp layered shock diamonds. They travel only backward behind the stern, leaving the hull surfaces unobstructed. Beautiful short powerful luminous wakes remain fully inside the canvas.
2. A compact intensely glowing amber-gold Yamato energy charge inside the FRONT primary cannon aperture, with a small contained rotating corona and a few bright electric filaments hugging the weapon. Show the weapon mouth and its supporting hull clearly. This is a charged-ready state, not a huge beam across the screen.
3. A few disciplined icy-blue electrical arcs around the aft engine housings and small energy vents. Sparse golden charged particles trail the rear wake. Keep virtually all effects in exterior negative space or their actual engine/weapon openings. At least 85 percent of the solid hull remains cleanly visible. No energy cloud over the bridge, no continuous halo across the bow, no planet-sized portal.

LIGHTING: Broad neutral key light from upper left makes the top and side armour readable; cool rim defines the far edge. Restrained amber bounce from the charged cannon and cyan bounce from thrusters. Strong tonal separation, rich shadows with visible structural detail, no black silhouette or metallic glare obliterating plates.

RESOURCE COMPOSITION: One standalone cutout, centred in a wide landscape canvas, roughly 3:2 to 16:9. The solid ship uses about 70 percent of canvas width; ship PLUS ALL flames and particles stay within the inner 86 percent of the canvas. At least 7 percent empty margin to every edge, including engine exhaust tips and antennae. Full silhouette, clean non-aliased alpha edges, no cropping, no overlapping copies, no grid. Preserve soft translucent alpha in the engine light and tiny particle glow while the armour is fully opaque. Native high-resolution production finish with crisp silhouette at small scale.

BACKGROUND REQUIREMENT: Genuine RGBA alpha transparency. Outside the ship and its localized effects, every pixel is TRANSPARENT. Do not draw a checkerboard to imitate transparency. Do not add a sky, starfield, hangar, planet, smoke backdrop, ground plane, floor shadow, pedestal, frame or environmental lighting gradient. No background at all.

No text, labels, ranks, logos, numerals, names, lettering, watermarks, UI, card frame, extra ships, people, miniature pilots, chibi exaggeration, wheel or car parts, arbitrary circular reactor, oversized fairy wings, disconnected hull pieces, huge random horns, smoke covering the hull or cropped thrust flames. One highly legible, spectacular Battlecruiser transport resource with real alpha transparency.

Use case: background-extraction.
Input image 1 is the ONLY edit target: the newly created blue-and-gunmetal Battlecruiser with golden charged front cannon and blue rear exhaust.

This is strictly a BACKGROUND REMOVAL operation. The grey-and-white checkerboard currently in the input is PAINTED PIXELS, not real transparency. Remove ALL of those checkerboard pixels and the faint white swirl remnants surrounding the ship. Return an actual transparent RGBA PNG, with alpha zero outside the ship and its localized effects. Do NOT draw another checkerboard, white surface, grey surface, black surface, shadow, gradient or sky.

Preserve the EXACT Battlecruiser design, panel shapes, turrets, barrels, bridge windows, masts, blue accent panels, camera angle, proportions, position, sharp detail and existing colour. Preserve the exact blue engine flames behind both rear engine clusters, including the soft blue glow and transparent wisps. Keep the golden main-cannon charge and its tiny electrical arcs. These emitters have soft partly transparent edges, not solid rectangular white or black mattes.

Do not redraw or simplify the ship. Do not change the framing or add anything. Keep the entire nose, side barrels, topmost antenna, rear engines and every exhaust tip. Every fully solid armour pixel remains opaque. Clean anti-aliased edge transitions. The only background is true alpha transparency, so this standalone ship can be composited onto a game interface of ANY colour. One transparent PNG cutout only, no labels or UI.

Increase the existing rear engine plumes with richer layered cyan shock diamonds and white-hot cores, still firing backward only from the original outlets. Add sparse coherent blue/gold sparks near the aura and small star-like glints at a few armour edge intersections. Local blue-white light reflects plausibly on nearby metallic bevels; the weapon charge supplies restrained golden bounce. Spectacular highest-tier power-up presentation, visibly more energetic than the input, but exceptionally sharp shape readability.

FRAMING: Keep the same view and original ship proportions. If needed uniformly shrink the entire original ship a little and add empty margin so the complete ship, antenna tips, cannon tips, the full wrapping aura and both engine wakes fit inside the canvas with at least 6 percent breathing room. Never crop a component or effect. One complete vehicle only.

OUTPUT: Native high-resolution PNG cutout with actual alpha transparency outside the ship and effects. Translucent aura fringes; opaque armour. No scene, floor, starscape, smoke background, shadow, frame, poster, text, labels, logos or UI. Do not paint a fake checkerboard. No new mechanical parts or added wheels. Preserve this approved Battlecruiser; add the beautiful enveloping aura.
